windowManager: The window manager for everyone on this computer. Both start from the same login screen and use **DankMaterialShell** for the bar, launcher and lock screen. !!Takes effect after a restart.!!
kernel: The Linux kernel this computer boots; setup.sh picks **Zen**. **CachyOS** compiles on this computer, which !!takes a long time!!, and needs a CPU with AVX2 (x86-64-v3). !!Takes effect after a restart.!!
cursor: The mouse pointer: **Bibata Modern Ice**, or **Catppuccin** Mocha Mauve to match the rest of the desktop.
mullvad.enable: **Mullvad VPN** over WireGuard, with multihop and DAITA. A kill switch blocks all traffic while the tunnel is down. !!Needs a Mullvad account.!!
mullvad.splitTunnel: Apps switched on here always go around the VPN and use your normal connection.
ssh.enable: Lets you log in to this computer from another device over **SSH**, with a key only: no passwords and no root login. **fail2ban** bans an address for 12 hours after 3 failed attempts. !!Add your public key under Account first, or there's no way in.!!
clamav.enable: **ClamAV** antivirus: a background scanner, automatic virus-definition updates, and the **ClamTK** window for scanning files by hand.
docker.enable: **Docker** and **Docker Compose** for running containers. Admins join the docker group.
suwayomi.enable: A local manga reader with a web page at localhost:4567. Its launcher opens it in **Helium** after a password prompt, so !!turn on Helium too.!!
syncthing.enable: **Syncthing** keeps folders in sync between your devices directly, peer to peer. Runs as the main user; its settings page is at 127.0.0.1:8384.
sunshine.enable: **Sunshine** streams games from this computer to **Moonlight** apps on other devices on your home network. Its settings page is at https://localhost:47990.
ssh.authorizedKeys: Public keys allowed to log in over SSH on a computer with the SSH server on. A public key isn't a secret, so it's safe in the repo.
browsers.zen: **Zen** browser, set up with the **Arkenfox** and **Securefox** privacy tweaks.
browsers.helium: **Helium** browser. It also opens the Syncthing and Suwayomi pages as app windows.
browsers.ferdium: All your web messengers in one window with **Ferdium**; you pick the services inside the app.
terminals.kitty: **Kitty** terminal. The file manager's "open in terminal" entry opens Kitty.
fileBrowsers.nautilus: **Nautilus**, the regular file manager window, with an Open in Kitty entry in its right-click menu.
fileBrowsers.yazi: **Yazi**, a file manager that runs inside the terminal.
media.mpv: **mpv**, the video player. The Twitch browser and Moku play their videos in it.
media.freetube: Watch YouTube without an account in **FreeTube**; subscriptions stay on your computer. !!Close FreeTube before applying changes!!, or it overwrites its new settings when it exits.
media.videoTrimmer: Cut a clip out of a video without re-encoding it.
media.constrict: Re-encode a video so it fits a file size you choose.
media.moku: **Moku** reads manga, light novels and anime, with a button that opens the current episode in mpv. !!Built from source, so the first build is slow.!!
media.streamlinkTwitchGui: Browse **Twitch** and watch streams in mpv, with no ads and no Twitch account; your follow list stays on this computer.
media.boorusama: Browse booru image sites with **Boorusama**. Its data sits in an encrypted vault that the launcher unlocks with a password and locks again on exit.
media.tonkatsuBox: Track games, films, anime, manga, books and music in one local database with **Tonkatsu Box**, with imports from Steam and AniList. !!Needs its files in ~/.local/opt first!! (docs/local/local-binary-installs.md).
wallpaper: **Carousel** picks still images from the repo's wallpaper folder. **Engine** plays animated Wallpaper Engine scenes and videos from the Steam Workshop, and !!needs Wallpaper Engine bought on Steam.!! Mod+W opens the picker either way.
audio.reaper: **REAPER**, a program for recording and mixing (a DAW), with the **SWS** and **ReaPack** extensions.
audio.guitarix: **Guitarix**, a guitar amp simulator built as a chain of effects. Any guitar app also adds shared cabinet IRs, a tuner and **qpwgraph** for routing audio.
audio.tone3000: The official **NAM** player; browse and load amp captures and IRs from the **TONE3000** library inside the app.
audio.katanaFloorboard: Edit the patches on a **BOSS Katana MkII** amp from your computer. !!Needs its files in ~/.local/opt first!! (docs/local/local-binary-installs.md).
office.obsidian: **Obsidian** keeps your notes as Markdown files in folders called vaults.
office.homebank: **HomeBank** personal accounting: label your transactions and see a running balance.
security.bleachbit: **BleachBit** clears caches, logs and browser leftovers when you run it; nothing runs on a schedule.
security.keepassxc: **KeePassXC**, an offline password manager. Its vault file can be synced between devices with **Syncthing**.
system.resources: **Resources**, a system and process monitor: what's running and how much it uses.
scrcpy.enable: Show and control an **Android** phone or tablet from your computer, over USB or wifi. Nothing gets installed on the device.
gaming.steam: **Steam**, with **GE-Proton** for running Windows games. Installed for everyone on the computer once any user turns it on.
gaming.easyrpg: Plays **RPG Maker 2000/2003** games, plus a **Tobira no Densetsu** launcher upscaled in gamescope.
gaming.feedback: **feedBack**, a guitar rhythm game that plays **Guitar Pro** tabs through its own audio engine, with VST plugins and amp models, so your guitar signal is the game input.
gaming.rocksmith: Sets up **Rocksmith 2014** on Steam (Proton) to read your guitar through a **BOSS Katana**. !!A few install steps are done by hand!!: docs/gaming/rocksmith-2014.md.
gaming.ludusavi: **Ludusavi** backs up your game saves every day to ~/SyncBackups/<computer>/Ludusavi.
gaming.granblueRelinkMods: **RelinkModOrganizer** for data mods and **Reloaded-II** for code mods, for Granblue Fantasy Relink. !!Both are installed by hand outside the repo.!!
discord.goofcord: **Discord** with **Vencord** built in, through GoofCord. !!Built from source, so the first build is slow.!!
discord.arrpc.enable: Shows the Steam or Proton game you're playing on your **Discord** profile, through GoofCord.
japanese.ime: Type Japanese (hiragana, katakana and kanji) with **fcitx5** and **Mozc**.
japanese.vn: Tools for raw Japanese visual novels: a launcher that runs games in a Japanese locale, and **innoextract**, **cabextract** and **mdf2iso** for unpacking them.
